summary: IDF reports killing two Hamas operatives involved in the October 7 attacks, including a commander who oversaw Israeli hostages in Gaza. The military also disclosed that 170 Gazans presented as journalists were actually terrorists. Meanwhile, Iran's shadow banking network A7 was sanctioned by the US for facilitating IRGC and Hamas transactions.
key_points: IDF killed two Hamas operatives involved in the October 7 attacks, including a commander who oversaw Israeli hostages in Gaza. (Source: @idf_telegram/25261)
IDF revealed that 170 Gazans presented as journalists were actually Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad terrorists. (Source: @New_security8200/204070)
US Treasury sanctioned the Russia-linked A7 Network for facilitating IRGC, Hamas, and Iranian oil transactions worth over $17 billion. (Source: @shin_persian/10662)
Hamas sniper Tamer Hamaida, who plotted attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians, was killed in a strike in Khan Younis. (Source: @manniefabian/59302)
IDF eliminated Az al-Din Bayk, a Hamas Northern Brigade commander who oversaw the captivity of multiple Israeli hostages during the October 7 massacre. (Source: @New_security8200/204072)
Clashes erupted between Iranian security forces and terrorist elements in Rasak, southeastern Iran, resulting in initial casualties. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92324)
Saudi Arabia claimed to intercept a Houthi ballistic missile targeting Khamis Mushait. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7784)

sections.executive_summary: IDF operations continue targeting Hamas operatives linked to the October 7 attacks, with two key commanders eliminated in Gaza. The military disclosed that 170 individuals presented as journalists were actually terrorists. US sanctions targeted a Russia-linked shadow banking network facilitating IRGC and Hamas financial activities.

points: Iran's shadow banking network A7 was sanctioned by the US Treasury for facilitating transactions involving the IRGC, Hamas, and Iranian oil sales, processing over $17 billion globally from January 2025 through June 2026. (Source: @shin_persian/10662)
Clashes occurred between Iranian security forces and terrorist elements in Rasak, southeastern Iran, with initial reports indicating multiple terrorist fatalities. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92324)

Iran's central bank announced a new currency exchange program allowing citizens over 18 to purchase up to $10,000 with national cards, following continued rial devaluation reaching 260,000 tomans per dollar. (Source: @mamlekate/104729)

Iranian blogger Iman Sadeghi was sentenced to over 13 years in prison on charges including 'propaganda against the system' and 'spreading criminal content against national security.' (Source: @VahidOnline/78588)

Iranian wrestler Farzaneh Fazli criticized IRAN Wrestling Federation head Ehsan Hadadi, calling him the 'most infamous athlete in Iranian history' over his comments about female athletes. (Source: @VahidOnline/78589)

IDF killed two Hamas operatives involved in the October 7 attacks: one who took part in the kidnapping at Kibbutz Bari and another Hamas military wing commander in Jabalia. (Source: @idf_telegram/25261)

IDF revealed that 170 Gazans presented as journalists were actually Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad terrorists, with the military stating it never planned attacks resulting in 500 civilian deaths. (Source: @New_security8200/204070)

Az al-Din Bayk, commander of Hamas's Northern Gaza Brigade who oversaw the captivity of multiple Israeli hostages including Mia Amershi and Amit Buskila, was eliminated by IDF. (Source: @New_security8200/204072)

In the West Bank, Palestinian attackers threw stones at Israeli civilians near Yitzhar, leading to an Israeli injury and IDF response including arrest procedures and evidence collection. (Source: @New_security8200/204072)
Israeli snipers and military units continue operations in Gaza targeting Hamas infrastructure and operatives involved in the October 7 massacre. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94445)

IDF eliminated Hamas sniper Tamer Hamaida in Khan Younis, who had plotted various attacks including sniper operations against IDF troops and Israeli civilians throughout the war. (Source: @manniefabian/59302)
Az al-Din Bayk, commander of Hamas's Northern Gaza Brigade who directed hostage captivity operations during October 7, was killed in an IDF strike in Gaza. (Source: @New_security8200/204072)

In the West Bank, Palestinian attackers threw stones at Israeli civilians near Yitzhar in the Shomron region, resulting in one Israeli injury and subsequent IDF arrest operations. (Source: @New_security8200/204072)

IDF continues investigating and prosecuting internal military crimes including smuggling, espionage, and fraud involving the Health Ministry, with a special unit handling sensitive cases. (Source: @idf_telegram/25265)

Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza continue to pose threats to IDF forces and Israeli civilians, with ongoing military operations to neutralize these threats. (Source: @New_security8200/204070)
Hezbollah claimed responsibility for targeting Israeli positions in the Shebaa Farms and Kafr Shuba border areas with artillery and rocket fire. (Source: @redlinkleb/46243)
Cross-border tensions continue along the Lebanon-Israel border with ongoing exchanges of fire between Hezbollah and Israeli forces. (Source: @redlinkleb/46243)
Lebanese security sources reported Israeli drone activity over southern Lebanon, with Hezbollah monitoring movements near the Blue Line. (Source: @redlinkleb/46243)
Clashes erupted between Iranian security forces and terrorist elements in Rasak, southeastern Iran, with initial reports of multiple terrorist fatalities. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92324)
Iraqi security forces conducted operations in the western Anbar province targeting remnants of ISIS cells, resulting in the elimination of several operatives. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92324)
Syrian opposition groups reported increased Russian airstrikes in Idlib province, with casualties reported among civilian populations. (Source: @asafroz/53949)
Saudi Arabia announced intercepting a Houthi ballistic missile launched toward Khamis Mushait, claiming successful defense of Saudi territory. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7784)

UAE authorities classified an attempted aircraft hijacking on a flight bound for Israel as a terrorist operation, following an incident involving a passenger attempting to breach the cockpit. (Source: @N12chat/228114)

Gulf security sources reported Iranian attempts to expand influence in Saudi Arabia through proxy Houthis and popular mobilization forces, potentially targeting Kuwait and UAE. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94446)

sections.threat_assessment: The operational threat level remains high with continued IDF operations targeting Hamas infrastructure in Gaza and ongoing cross-border tensions with Hezbollah in Lebanon. Iranian-backed networks continue to pose significant threats through proxy groups and financial facilitation mechanisms. The A7 Network sanctions represent a major disruption to Iran's ability to fund regional operations including Hamas activities. Recent clashes in Iran's southeast indicate internal instability that could affect regional proxy operations. US and Israeli intelligence cooperation appears to be intensifying based on recent coordinated disclosures.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are responding to escalating tensions with heightened military preparedness and diplomatic initiatives. Saudi Arabia's missile interception claims demonstrate active defense postures against Houthi threats. The UAE's classification of aircraft hijacking attempts as terrorism reflects growing security concerns. European and US sanctions on Iranian financial networks signal coordinated international pressure. Israeli military operations in Gaza continue to draw regional condemnation while maintaining operational momentum against Hamas infrastructure.
sections.intelligence_notes: Recent IDF disclosures about Hamas operatives disguised as journalists reveal sophisticated intelligence gathering capabilities and highlight the complexity of distinguishing combatants from civilians in conflict zones. The A7 Network investigation demonstrates extensive US Treasury Department tracking of Russia-linked financial infrastructure supporting Iranian regional operations. Cross-border incidents in both Lebanon and the Gulf indicate multi-front pressure points requiring coordinated monitoring. Internal Iranian security challenges in Rasak suggest potential vulnerabilities in Tehran's domestic control that could impact regional proxy operations. Ongoing Israeli military investigations into internal corruption cases may affect operational security and resource allocation.
